The following unmodified browser bundles are served locally. No CDN is used.

jsqr.js: jsqr 1.4.0, Apache-2.0
Source: https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR
Retrieved from the official npm package jsqr@1.4.0 using npm pack --ignore-scripts.
npm tarball SHA-1: 8efb8d0a7cc6863cb6d95116b9069123ce9eb2d1
License: jsqr-LICENSE.txt

qrcode-generator.js: qrcode-generator 2.0.4, MIT
Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
Retrieved from the official npm package qrcode-generator@2.0.4 using npm pack --ignore-scripts.
npm tarball SHA-1: e8b3f30922577eba52078aa9c0d5a2a74fe1fd94
License: qrcode-generator-LICENSE.txt; original copyright and license notice also retained in the bundle.
